draft.ask: ASK: Dahil may end-jejunostomy ako, gaano kadalas dapat i-check ang sodium at hydration ko habang umiinom ng spironolactone suspension?
draft.verdict: Malamang na mas madaling ma-absorb ang likidong gamot na ito, pero ang spironolactone ay diuretic, at maaari itong dagdagan ang panganib ng dehydration at mababang sodium sa taong may stoma, kaya mainam itong pag-usapan sa inyong care team.

why.claim: Ang gamot na ito ay suspension, isang likidong anyo.
Sa short bowel syndrome, maaaring mas maaasahan ang pag-absorb ng likidong gamot kaysa sa solid na tableta, pero madalas may sugar alcohol ang likidong gamot na puwedeng magpalakas ng output.
Ang sorbitol at iba pang sugar alcohol ay humihila ng tubig papunta sa bituka at puwedeng magpataas ng stoma output.

Bahagi lang ng listahan ng inactive ingredients ang nakita ko: sorbic acid, potassium sorbate, citric acid anhydrous. Putol ang listahan at walang hiwalay na seksyon ng inactive ingredients, kaya hindi ko makumpirma kung walang sugar alcohol. (Ang sorbic acid at potassium sorbate ay hindi sorbitol.)
Ang mga taong may stoma ay mas mataas ang panganib ng dehydration at mababang sodium, at ang mga gamot tulad ng diuretic ay puwedeng magdagdag sa panganib na iyon.
Ang pagkauhaw, madilim o kaunting ihi, pagkahilo kapag tumatayo, at pagtaas ng stoma output ay mga babalang senyales ng dehydration na dapat sabihin agad sa care team.
Ayon sa label, ang pagkaing mataas sa taba at calorie ay nagpataas ng dami ng spironolactone na na-absorb ng mga 90%.

G:aga-sbs#dehydration-signs.text: Thirst, dark or reduced urine, dizziness on standing, and rising stoma output are warning signs of dehydration that should be raised with the care team promptly.

G:pg139#liquid-forms.text: Liquid forms may be absorbed more reliably than solid tablets in short bowel syndrome, but liquid medicines often contain sugar alcohols that can increase output.

G:pg139#sugar-alcohols.text: Sorbitol, xylitol, mannitol and other sugar alcohols are poorly absorbed, draw water into the gut, and can raise stoma output or diarrhea; they are common inactive ingredients in liquid medicines and sugar-free products.

final.verdict: Maaaring mas maaasahan ang pag-absorb ng likidong anyo, pero hindi ko makumpirma kung walang sugar alcohol ito, at ayon sa guideline, ang mga gamot tulad ng diuretic ay puwedeng magdagdag sa panganib ng dehydration at mababang sodium sa taong may ileostomy, kaya mainam itong pag-usapan sa inyong care team.

why.claim: Ang gamot na ito ay suspension, isang likidong anyo.
Sa short bowel syndrome, maaaring mas maaasahan ang pag-absorb ng likidong gamot kaysa sa solid na tableta, pero madalas may sugar alcohol ang likidong gamot na puwedeng magpalakas ng output.
Ang sorbitol at iba pang sugar alcohol ay humihila ng tubig papunta sa bituka at puwedeng magpataas ng stoma output.

Bahagi lang ng listahan ng inactive ingredients ang nakita ko: sorbic acid, potassium sorbate, citric acid anhydrous. Putol ang listahan at walang hiwalay na seksyon ng inactive ingredients, kaya hindi ko makumpirma kung walang sugar alcohol. (Ang sorbic acid at potassium sorbate ay hindi sorbitol.)
Ang mga taong may ileostomy ay mas mataas ang panganib ng dehydration at mababang sodium, at ang mga gamot tulad ng diuretic ay puwedeng magdagdag sa panganib na iyon.
Ang pagkauhaw, madilim o kaunting ihi, pagkahilo kapag tumatayo, at pagtaas ng stoma output ay mga babalang senyales ng dehydration na dapat sabihin agad sa care team.
Ayon sa label, ang pagkaing mataas sa taba at calorie ay nagpataas ng dami ng spironolactone na na-absorb ng mga 90%.

draft.ask: ASK: Com minha ileostomia, sem o intestino grosso ligado, o comprimido revestido de SINGULAIR (montelucaste) deve ser bem absorvido?

diagram.label: Most medicines are absorbed in the upper small bowel

sourcesChecked: FDA label: faltavam inactive_ingredient, warnings, boxed_warning, spl_unclassified_section, spl_patient_package_insert, instructions_for_use
Diretrizes: Remane 2025, AGA SBS 2022, Sood 2013, Practical Gastroenterology #139
draft.verdict: Nada nas fontes que consultei aponta um problema de absorção do SINGULAIR (montelucaste) comprimido revestido com a sua ileostomia. Mas partes da bula estavam faltando, então isso não é uma garantia.

why.claim: O registro do produto diz que é um comprimido revestido.
Comprimidos simples, que se dissolvem rápido, estão no grupo de menor risco de não dissolver em quem tem estomia. Os de liberação prolongada e os com revestimento entérico são os de maior risco.
A maioria dos remédios é absorvida no começo do intestino delgado. Por isso, muitos comprimidos de liberação imediata ainda são absorvidos quando essa parte continua lá.
O quanto um remédio é absorvido depende mais do comprimento e da saúde do intestino delgado que sobrou do que do tipo de estomia.
O intestino grosso importa principalmente para remédios de liberação lenta, que soltam parte da dose lá.
Na bula, em média 64% da dose tomada pela boca chega ao sangue.

Os ingredientes inativos listados são celulose microcristalina, lactose mono-hidratada e croscarmelose sódica. Nenhum deles é sorbitol nem outro álcool de açúcar. A lactose está na lista; se você tem dúvida sobre lactose, vale perguntar.
Quem tem ileostomia tem mais risco de desidratação e sódio baixo. Isso é útil saber em geral, mas não é algo que encontrei sobre este remédio.

draft.verdict: बेनिकार (olmesartan medoxomil) एक सादी, तुरंत घुलने वाली गोली है, और जिन स्रोतों को मैंने देखा उनमें आपके शरीर के लिए कोई खास चेतावनी नहीं मिली, पर छोटी आंत कम होने से दवा कितनी सोखी जाएगी, यह पक्का नहीं कहा जा सकता।

why.claim: बेनिकार एक फिल्म-कोटेड गोली है, धीरे-धीरे या देर से निकलने वाली (एक्सटेंडेड/एंटेरिक-कोटेड) गोली नहीं।
ज़्यादातर दवाएं छोटी आंत के ऊपरी हिस्से (जेजुनम की शुरुआत) में सोखी जाती हैं, इसलिए वह हिस्सा बचा हो तो कई सादी, तुरंत घुलने वाली दवाएं सोखी जा सकती हैं।
सादी, जल्दी घुलने वाली गोलियों को स्टोमा वाले लोगों में कम जोखिम वाली श्रेणी में रखा गया है।
दवा कितनी सोखी जाएगी, यह स्टोमा के प्रकार से ज़्यादा बची हुई छोटी आंत की लंबाई और सेहत पर निर्भर करता है। आपकी छोटी आंत 100 सेमी से कम है।

G:aga-sbs#medications-proximal-absorptio.text: Most oral medicines are absorbed in the upper small bowel (the first part of the jejunum), so many plain immediate-release drugs can still be absorbed when that segment remains.

G:hong-2021#absorption-findings.text: Across studies reviewed, absorption was decreased for 29 of 37 drugs after intestinal resection, and 6 drugs lost clinical effect; the effect was drug-specific, so it cannot be turned into a single probability for one person.

G:remane-2025#formulation-classes.text: Oral formulations can be grouped by dissolution risk in ostomy patients as noncritical (for example solutions and plain fast-dissolving tablets), potentially critical, and critical (for example extended-release and enteric-coated products).

G:sood-2013#residual-length.text: How well oral medicines are absorbed tracks the length and health of the remaining small bowel more than the type of stoma.

why.claim: ज़्यादातर दवाएं छोटी आंत के ऊपरी हिस्से (जेजुनम की शुरुआत) में सोखी जाती हैं, इसलिए वह हिस्सा बचा हो तो कई सादी, तुरंत घुलने वाली दवाएं सोखी जा सकती हैं।
सादी, जल्दी घुलने वाली गोलियों को स्टोमा वाले लोगों में कम जोखिम वाली (noncritical) श्रेणी में रखा गया है।
दवा कितनी सोखी जाएगी, यह स्टोमा के प्रकार से ज़्यादा बची हुई छोटी आंत की लंबाई और सेहत पर निर्भर करता है।
आंत का हिस्सा निकाले जाने के बाद 37 में से 29 दवाओं का सोखना कम पाया गया, और 6 दवाओं का असर खत्म हो गया; यह हर दवा के लिए अलग होता है, इसलिए किसी एक व्यक्ति के लिए पहले से नहीं कहा जा सकता।

draft.verdict: जिन स्रोतों को मैंने देखा, उनमें आपकी इलियोस्टोमी के लिए Tricor गोली के खिलाफ़ कोई खास चेतावनी नहीं मिली। पर लेबल यह नहीं बताता कि यह आंत के किस हिस्से में सोखी जाती है, और यह पानी में लगभग घुलती ही नहीं, इसलिए फार्मासिस्ट से पूछना अच्छा रहेगा।

why.claim: लेबल में दवा का रूप 'TABLET' (गोली) लिखा है। यह धीरे-धीरे घुलने वाली या खास परत वाली गोली के रूप में नहीं लिखी है।
लेबल में यह नहीं लिखा कि दवा आंत के किस हिस्से में सोखी जाती है। लेबल सिर्फ़ इतना कहता है कि फेनोफाइब्रेट पानी में लगभग घुलता ही नहीं है।
ज़्यादातर दवाएं छोटी आंत के ऊपरी हिस्से में सोखी जाती हैं। जब यह हिस्सा बचा हो, तो कई सामान्य गोलियां सोखी जा सकती हैं।
स्टोमा वाले लोगों में सामान्य, जल्दी घुलने वाली गोलियों को कम जोखिम वाला माना गया है। धीरे-धीरे घुलने वाली और खास परत वाली दवाओं को ज़्यादा जोखिम वाला माना गया है।
दवा कितनी अच्छी तरह सोखी जाती है, यह स्टोमा के प्रकार से ज़्यादा इस पर निर्भर करता है कि छोटी आंत कितनी लंबी और कितनी स्वस्थ बची है।
आंत का हिस्सा निकाले जाने के बाद अध्ययनों में 37 में से 29 दवाओं का सोखना कम हुआ। यह असर हर दवा में अलग होता है, इसलिए किसी एक व्यक्ति के लिए पक्का नहीं कहा जा सकता।
लेबल कहता है कि Tricor दिन में एक बार, खाने के साथ या बिना, लें और हर गोली पूरी निगलें। कोई भी बदलाव फार्मासिस्ट या डॉक्टर का निर्णय है।
लेबल के विवरण में गोली में hypromellose, docusate sodium और sucrose जैसी चीज़ें लिखी हैं। बाकी सामग्री (inactive ingredients) वाला हिस्सा लेबल में नहीं मिला।
अगर दवा का उम्मीद के मुताबिक असर न दिखे, तो हो सकता है कि वह ठीक से सोखी नहीं जा रही। यह बात डॉक्टर या फार्मासिस्ट को बताएं।

दवा कितनी अच्छी तरह सोखी जाती है, यह स्टोमा के प्रकार से ज़्यादा इस पर निर्भर करता है कि छोटी आंत कितनी लंबी और कितनी स्वस्थ बची है।
आंत का हिस्सा निकाले जाने के बाद अध्ययनों में 37 में से 29 दवाओं का सोखना कम हुआ। यह असर हर दवा में अलग होता है, इसलिए किसी एक व्यक्ति के लिए पक्का नहीं कहा जा सकता।
लेबल कहता है कि Tricor दिन में एक बार, खाने के साथ या बिना, लें और हर गोली पूरी निगलें। कोई भी बदलाव फार्मासिस्ट या डॉक्टर का निर्णय है।
लेबल के विवरण में गोली में hypromellose, docusate sodium और sucrose जैसी चीज़ें लिखी हैं। बाकी सामग्री (inactive ingredients) वाला हिस्सा लेबल में नहीं मिला।
अगर दवा का उम्मीद के मुताबिक असर न दिखे, तो हो सकता है कि वह ठीक से सोखी नहीं जा रही। यह बात डॉक्टर या फार्मासिस्ट को बताएं।

Sem o cólon, os produtos de liberação lenta têm menos tempo e menos espaço no intestino para liberar o remédio.

Guidelines: AGA SBS update, Practical Gastroenterology #139, Sood 2013, Parrish & DiBaise 2017
draft.verdict: నేను చూసిన మూలాల్లో లేబెటలాల్ హైడ్రోక్లోరైడ్ మామూలు (వెంటనే కరిగే) మాత్ర మీ శరీరానికి పనిచేయదు అని చెప్పే విషయం ఏదీ దొరకలేదు. కానీ లేబెల్ వివరాలు పూర్తిగా అందలేదు, అందుకే మీ ఫార్మసిస్ట్‌ను అడగండి.

why.claim: ఇది మాత్ర (టాబ్లెట్) రూపంలో ఉంది. ఇది వెంటనే కరిగే రకం. నెమ్మదిగా కరిగే రకం కాదు.
చాలా మందులు చిన్న ప్రేగు మొదటి భాగంలోనే శోషించబడతాయి. అందుకే ఆ భాగం మిగిలి ఉంటే చాలా మామూలు మాత్రలు ఇంకా శోషించబడగలవు.
మందు ఎంత బాగా శోషించబడుతుంది అనేది మిగిలిన చిన్న ప్రేగు పొడవు, ఆరోగ్యం మీద ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. మీకు 100 సెం.మీ. కంటే తక్కువ ఉంది కాబట్టి ఇది అడగాల్సిన విషయం.
మాత్రల కంటే ద్రవ రూప మందులు కొన్నిసార్లు బాగా శోషించబడతాయి. కానీ వాటిలో తరచుగా షుగర్ ఆల్కహాల్స్ ఉంటాయి, అవి మలం ఎక్కువ చేయగలవు.

draft.verdict: L'eau gazeuse est une eau pauvre en sel. Avec une iléostomie sans côlon, ce type de boisson mérite qu'on en parle avec votre équipe, car les sources signalent un risque de déshydratation et de manque de sel.

why.claim: Les personnes avec une iléostomie ont un risque plus élevé de déshydratation et de manque de sel (sodium).

Quand l'intestin s'arrête au jéjunum (stomie haute), l'eau plate et les autres boissons pauvres en sel peuvent attirer le sel dans l'intestin et faire monter le débit de la stomie. On les limite donc souvent au profit d'une solution de réhydratation orale. Cette règle est écrite pour une stomie plus haute que la vôtre. Il faut donc demander à votre équipe si elle s'applique à vous.
Une solution de réhydratation orale (sucre + sels) est la boisson conseillée pour remplacer l'eau et le sel perdus en cas de grêle court.
Pour le grêle court, on cite en général des solutions contenant environ 90 à 120 mmol/L de sodium. C'est plus que beaucoup de boissons de réhydratation vendues dans le commerce.
On conseille en général de boire par petites gorgées tout au long de la journée plutôt qu'en grande quantité d'un coup. Beaucoup d'équipes conseillent aussi de boire à distance des repas.
La soif, des urines foncées ou plus rares, des vertiges en se levant et un débit de stomie qui augmente sont des signes de déshydratation. Il faut les signaler vite à votre équipe.
Parmi les personnes avec une iléostomie qui ont noté l'eau, 6 sur 13 disent qu'elle leur a fait du mal, 5 n'ont rien remarqué et 2 disent qu'elle les a aidées.

G:aga-sbs#dehydration-signs.text: Thirst, dark or reduced urine, dizziness on standing, and rising stoma output are warning signs of dehydration that should be raised with the care team promptly.

G:aga-sbs#fluids-ors.text: A glucose-electrolyte oral rehydration solution (ORS) is the preferred drink to replace fluid and sodium losses in short bowel syndrome, especially with a jejunostomy.

G:aga-sbs#fluids-sipping.text: Fluids are generally sipped through the day rather than taken in large amounts at once, and many teams suggest separating drinks from meals.

G:pd-2017#ors-sodium.text: For short bowel syndrome, oral rehydration solutions with a sodium concentration of about 90 to 120 mmol/L are generally recommended; this is higher than many commercial rehydration drinks.

G:sood-2013#ileostomy-dehydration.text: People with an ileostomy are at higher risk of dehydration and low sodium, and medicines such as diuretics and laxatives can add to that risk.

evidence.G:aga-sbs#dehydration-signs: Thirst, dark or reduced urine, dizziness on standing, and rising stoma output are warning signs of dehydration that should be raised with the care team promptly.
evidence.G:aga-sbs#diet-simple-sugars: Concentrated simple sugars (sweets, syrups, sweetened drinks) draw water into the bowel and are generally limited in short bowel syndrome.
evidence.G:aga-sbs#fluids-hypertonic: Hypertonic, sugary drinks such as fruit juice and regular soda pull water into the gut and can raise stoma output or diarrhea in short bowel syndrome; they are best limited regardless of anatomy.
evidence.G:aga-sbs#fluids-ors: A glucose-electrolyte oral rehydration solution (ORS) is the preferred drink to replace fluid and sodium losses in short bowel syndrome, especially with a jejunostomy.
evidence.G:aga-sbs#fluids-sipping: Fluids are generally sipped through the day rather than taken in large amounts at once, and many teams suggest separating drinks from meals.
evidence.G:pd-2017#caffeine-alcohol: Caffeine and alcohol can increase output and fluid losses and are usually limited in short bowel syndrome.
evidence.G:pd-2017#ors-sodium: For short bowel syndrome, oral rehydration solutions with a sodium concentration of about 90 to 120 mmol/L are generally recommended; this is higher than many commercial rehydration drinks.
evidence.G:pd-2017#salt: Salting food and choosing salty snacks is commonly encouraged in short bowel syndrome with high output, within the care team's advice for the person's heart and kidney health.
evidence.G:pd-2017#sports-drinks: Typical sports drinks are low in sodium and high in sugar compared with an SBS oral rehydration solution, so they are not a substitute for it.
evidence.G:pg139#sugar-alcohols: Sorbitol, xylitol, mannitol and other sugar alcohols are poorly absorbed, draw water into the gut, and can raise stoma output or diarrhea; they are common inactive ingredients in liquid medicines and sugar-free products.
evidence.G:sood-2013#ileostomy-dehydration: People with an ileostomy are at higher risk of dehydration and low sodium, and medicines such as diuretics and laxatives can add to that risk.
evidence.G:who-ors#purpose: Oral rehydration solution works because glucose and sodium are absorbed together in the small bowel, carrying water with them.
evidence.G:who-ors#reduced-osmolarity-composition: WHO reduced-osmolarity ORS (2003) contains sodium 75 mmol/L, chloride 65, glucose 75, potassium 20 and citrate 10 mmol/L (total 245 mOsm/L). It was designed for acute diarrhea, and its sodium is below the range usually cited for short bowel syndrome.

draft.verdict: For your parent's Femara (letrozole), a plain tablet that releases right away, I found nothing in the sources I checked that would stop it from being absorbed with their anatomy.

why.claim: This medicine is a tablet that releases right away. It is not a slow-release or coated form.
The label says letrozole is quickly and completely absorbed from the gut, and food does not change this.
Most medicines are absorbed in the upper small bowel. Many plain tablets that release right away can still be absorbed when that part is still there.
How well medicines are absorbed depends more on how much healthy small bowel is left than on the type of stoma.
Studies of people with an ostomy put plain tablets that dissolve fast in the lowest-risk group. Slow-release and coated products are the riskier ones.

draft.ask: ASK: Con mi yeyunostomía y menos de 100 cm de intestino, ¿cómo podemos comprobar si el fenofibrato me está funcionando?

diagram.label: Most medicines are absorbed in the upper small bowel

sourcesChecked: Guidelines: poorly soluble drug absorption in short bowel
draft.verdict: No encontré ningún problema concreto en las fuentes que revisé, pero tampoco hay datos que confirmen que el fenofibrato se absorbe bien con su intestino corto. Eso solo se puede saber en su caso con su equipo médico.

why.claim: La etiqueta indica la forma solo como 'tableta'. No menciona liberación prolongada ni retardada.
Las tabletas de liberación prolongada o con capa entérica suelen evitarse tras una resección grande del intestino. Eso no aparece en esta etiqueta.
La mayoría de los medicamentos se absorben en la parte alta del intestino delgado. Por eso muchas tabletas normales se pueden absorber si esa parte sigue ahí.
Qué tan bien se absorbe un medicamento depende sobre todo del largo y la salud del intestino que queda.
En estudios con personas operadas del intestino, 29 de 37 medicamentos se absorbieron menos. Depende de cada medicamento y no se puede predecir para una persona.
La etiqueta dice que el fenofibrato casi no se disuelve en agua. Por eso no se pudo medir del todo cuánto absorbe el cuerpo.
La etiqueta dice que se toma una vez al día, con o sin comida, y que la tableta se traga entera.
Entre los ingredientes, la etiqueta nombra hipromelosa, docusato de sodio y sacarosa. No encontré la lista completa de ingredientes inactivos.
Nadie ha registrado todavía cómo le fue con el fenofibrato, ni con su tipo de estoma ni con otros.

draft.verdict: The liquid form may absorb well for your parent, but this nitrofurantoin suspension contains sorbitol, which can make diarrhea worse in short bowel syndrome, so it's worth checking with the pharmacist.

why.claim: This product is a liquid suspension.
The label lists sorbitol as one of its inactive ingredients.
In short bowel syndrome, liquid medicines may be absorbed more reliably than solid tablets. But they often contain sugar alcohols, which can increase output.
Sorbitol is poorly absorbed. It draws water into the gut and can make diarrhea or stoma output worse.
The label says food, or anything that slows stomach emptying, can increase how much nitrofurantoin the body takes in.
When a medicine might cause problems after bowel surgery, the care team may consider other forms of the same drug.

draft.verdict: This mirabegron is an extended-release tablet, and the guidelines say slow-release medicines often don't fully work after a large part of the bowel is removed, especially with no colon, so your parent's body may not get the whole dose.

why.claim: The label lists this medicine as an extended-release tablet.
The label says not to chew, divide, or crush it.
Even in a full-length bowel, only about 29% to 35% of the dose reaches the blood.
After a large part of the small bowel is removed, slow-release medicines are usually avoided. They need a long, normal trip through the gut to let the medicine out.
When the bowel is shorter or moves fast, part of the dose may leave the body before it is released.
Slow-release products may let out part of their dose in the colon. Without a colon, they get less time and less surface to do that. Your parent's colon is not connected.
How well pills are absorbed depends most on how long and healthy the remaining small bowel is.
Crushing an extended-release product defeats its design and can be dangerous. Whether to change how a medicine is taken is the pharmacist's decision.
If you ever see a whole tablet or shell in the pouch, show the pharmacist. It may mean the pill did not dissolve, or it may be an empty shell. It is not proof either way.

why.claim: The label lists this medicine as an extended-release tablet.
The label says not to chew, divide, or crush it.
The label says only about 29% to 35% of the dose reaches the blood.
After a large part of the small bowel is removed, slow-release medicines are usually avoided. They need a long, normal trip through the gut to let the medicine out.
When the bowel is shorter or moves fast, part of the dose may leave the body before it is released.
Slow-release products may let out part of their dose in the colon. Without a colon, they get less time and less surface to do that.
How well pills are absorbed depends most on how long and healthy the remaining small bowel is.
Crushing an extended-release product defeats its design and can be dangerous. Any change in how a medicine is taken is a decision for your pharmacist or prescriber.
If you ever see a whole tablet or shell in the pouch, show the pharmacist. It may mean the pill did not dissolve, or it may be an empty shell. It is not proof either way.

draft.verdict: لم أجد شيئًا في المصادر التي راجعتها يمنع نيورونتين (غابابنتين) أقراصًا سريعة الإطلاق مع فغرتك اللفائفية. لكن المصادر لا تتحدث عن هذا الدواء تحديدًا، وقد يكون امتصاصه أقل بعد استئصال جزء من الأمعاء.

why.claim: قرصك سريع الإطلاق، أي ليس ممتد الإطلاق.
كيف يمتصه الجسم: معظم الأدوية تُمتص في الجزء العلوي من الأمعاء الدقيقة. لذلك يمكن أن تُمتص كثير من الأقراص العادية سريعة الإطلاق إذا بقي هذا الجزء.
تقول النشرة إن الجسم يمتص نسبة أقل من الغابابنتين كلما زادت الجرعة اليومية. وهذه معلومة عامة عن الدواء، وليست خاصة بالفغرة.
الأقراص العادية سريعة الذوبان تُعدّ من الأشكال «غير الحرجة» عند مرضى الفغرة. أما الأشكال ممتدة الإطلاق والمغلفة معويًا فتُعدّ «حرجة».

عادةً يُتجنَّب الدواء ممتد الإطلاق أو متأخر الإطلاق بعد استئصال جزء كبير من الأمعاء الدقيقة. والسبب أنه يحتاج إلى مرور طويل وطبيعي في الأمعاء حتى يخرج منه الدواء. إذا تغيّر شكل الدواء الذي تأخذه يومًا ما، فهذه نقطة تستحق السؤال عنها.
مدى امتصاص الأدوية يعتمد على طول ما بقي من الأمعاء الدقيقة وصحته، أكثر مما يعتمد على نوع الفغرة.
في الدراسات، قلّ امتصاص كثير من الأدوية بعد استئصال جزء من الأمعاء. لكن هذا يختلف من دواء لآخر، ولا يمكن تحويله إلى نسبة محددة لشخص واحد.
إذا كان الدواء قد لا يُمتص جيدًا، فقد يفكر الفريق الطبي في شكل آخر من الدواء نفسه، مثل الشكل السائل أو الذي يذوب.
الأدوية السائلة قد تُمتص بشكل أوثق من الأقراص الصلبة. لكنها كثيرًا ما تحتوي على كحولات سكرية قد تزيد كمية الخارج من الفغرة.
في بيانات المنتج المتاحة، المكونات المذكورة غير الغابابنتين هي نشا الذرة والكوبوفيدون فقط، ولا يوجد سوربيتول. قسم المكونات غير الفعالة الكامل لم يكن متاحًا.
مرضى الفغرة اللفائفية أكثر عرضة للجفاف ونقص الصوديوم.
